title: Hawkeye
summary: Clint Barton aka Hawkeye has the mission to get back to his family for Christmas. But when a threat from his past shows up, Hawkeye reluctantly teams up with Kate Bishop, a skilled archer and his biggest fan, to unravel a conspiracy. (source: IMDb)

reception.actors: Jeremy Renner, Hailee Steinfeld, Florence Pugh, Vera Farmiga, Vincent D'Onofrio
reception.awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 4 wins & 22 nominations total.
